pitch_peak_delay_morae.note: native F0 peak lies in the mora after the nucleus in ~53% of atamadaka and ~24% of nakadaka phrases; mora-level values cannot separate nucleus k from k+1 either way

gop_norms._method: one scale for all phones (center 0): the 0.5% quantile of the worst native GOP per mora (tune speakers) / z at the mispronounced threshold, so native morae fall below it at that rate. Native GOP is a point mass at 0, so per-phone z-scores are degenerate
gop_norms._dataset: JVS parallel100, 2986 utts, 80 tune / 20 test speakers; synthetic one-mora substitutions on the same audio (spec B.4)
gop_norms._metric: scale 1.8929 (speaker bootstrap 90% [1.822, 1.975]); test speakers: native mora < threshold 0.59%, synthetic substitution detected 0.9412; native mean mora score 99.25
